source_licence_note: Official/primary public Environment Agency/Defra, Ordnance Survey and EPSG documentation/services; selected-dataset licence remains per-record evidence.

official_sources.title: Defra Survey Data Download workflow
official_sources.finding: AOI can be drawn/uploaded; available survey tiles are enumerated by product, year and resolution; National LIDAR Programme and Composite are supplied as 5km GeoTIFF tiles.
official_sources.limitation: Interactive browser download behavior is discovery evidence; terminal automation must capture exact selected tile identities.

official_sources.title: Survey Data Catalogue large-area download limits
official_sources.finding: Open portal download is organized in 5km x 5km tiles and is not a whole-country bulk endpoint.
official_sources.limitation: Parcel acquisition should request only intersecting tiles and must not infer a hidden national bulk file.

official_sources.title: LiDAR ASCII-to-GeoTIFF transition
official_sources.finding: EA Composite 1m/2m moved to GeoTIFF in 5km tiles; GeoTIFF enables image/WCS web services.
official_sources.limitation: Web services are convenience paths; immutable downloaded source identity still needs digest/readback.

official_sources.title: LiDAR WMS preview semantics
official_sources.finding: EA states WMS Preview is only an image and cannot be queried.
official_sources.limitation: Rendered preview pixels are rejected as numeric elevation evidence.

official_sources.title: EA LiDAR projection and vertical datum
official_sources.finding: EA data are supplied in OSGB36 British National Grid with elevations above Ordnance Datum Newlyn; time-stamped surveys retain survey-specific geoid provenance.
official_sources.limitation: Horizontal CRS alone is insufficient; vertical datum/geoid are mandatory provenance.

official_sources.title: LiDAR metadata index GeoPackage transition
official_sources.finding: Composite/SurfZone download zips now contain spatial metadata index GeoPackages describing spatial location and temporal extent.
official_sources.limitation: Raster and metadata index must be paired and independently digested.

official_sources.title: LiDAR data metadata catalogues
official_sources.finding: EA provides downloadable index catalogues for its survey products, including collection-time information.
official_sources.limitation: Index catalogue identity is part of source-selection evidence.

official_sources.title: Current LiDAR capture programme
official_sources.finding: EA exposes current and previous capture programme seasons.
official_sources.limitation: Recency is a candidate-selection signal, not proof that a newer capture is automatically the correct terrain source.

official_sources.title: LiDAR vertical accuracy FAQ
official_sources.finding: EA specification uses absolute-height RMSE less than ±15cm and expected relative/random error no more than ±5cm.
official_sources.limitation: RMSE and relative error remain separately labelled metrics.

official_sources.title: LiDAR Ground Truth Surveys
official_sources.finding: Independent ground-truth points are ±3cm RMSE and include survey date, surface type, method, transformation and geoidal models; survey QC compares RMSE, standard deviation and random error.
official_sources.limitation: Ground-truth applicability/age must be verified before reuse.

official_sources.title: LiDAR point density guidance
official_sources.finding: Point-cloud density depends on intended surface resolution and is not itself a regular-grid resolution; DTM density under vegetation may be lower.
official_sources.limitation: Do not convert point density directly into DTM cell resolution or accuracy.

official_sources.title: LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles
official_sources.finding: Time-stamped bare-earth DTM is downloadable as 5km GeoTIFF zips at 25cm/50cm/1m/2m with ODN heights and survey-specific transform/geoid metadata.
official_sources.limitation: Actual parcel must bind one or more exact tile/survey records.

official_sources.title: LIDAR Time Stamped Point Cloud
official_sources.finding: Point-cloud archive is supplied in 5km zip files with LAZ files; historical raster and point-cloud products may not always have a one-to-one match.
official_sources.limitation: No matching point cloud may be invented when archive lineage is absent.

official_sources.title: LIDAR DSM Time Stamped Tiles
official_sources.finding: DSM time-stamped tiles include buildings/vegetation and expose survey/geoid metadata plus coverage downloads.
official_sources.limitation: DSM coverage metadata may aid discovery but DSM elevations are rejected for bare-earth terrain extrema.

official_sources.title: LIDAR Tiles Catalogues FeatureServer
official_sources.finding: Official FeatureServer exposes DTM and DSM time-stamped extent layers in EPSG:27700, supports JSON queries and has explicit record limits.
official_sources.limitation: Queries must handle pagination/limits and retain returned source records.

official_sources.title: LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Extents layer schema
official_sources.finding: DTM extent layer exposes filename, os_ref, flown dates, point spacing, transform, geoid, filepath, year, latest and polygon_id fields; geometry is polygon in EPSG:27700.
official_sources.limitation: These fields form a concrete parcel-to-survey acquisition ledger but do not replace downloaded raster validation.

official_sources.title: Defra Data Services Platform overview
official_sources.finding: DSP exposes APIs plus a Survey map/download tool for public survey datasets.
official_sources.limitation: Browser/API discovery and terminal source acquisition must be distinguished.

official_sources.title: Defra DSP licence overview
official_sources.finding: DSP instructs users to check each dataset licence; most are OGL or Conditional Licence.
official_sources.limitation: Licence and attribution text must be captured per selected dataset rather than assumed globally.

official_sources.title: EPSG:27700 OSGB36 / British National Grid
official_sources.finding: EPSG:27700 uses easting/northing Cartesian axes in metres and is scoped to engineering survey/topographic mapping.
official_sources.limitation: Parcel and tile spatial joins must be performed in the correct axis/unit semantics.

official_sources.title: OS National Grid tile naming
official_sources.finding: OS 5km tiles are identified from the National Grid reference of the south-west corner; grid references encode easting before northing.
official_sources.limitation: Tile-name derivation must be cross-checked against authoritative metadata, not guessed from filenames alone.

official_sources.title: OS Terrain 5 product supply
official_sources.finding: OS Terrain 5 national supply is tiled at 5km x 5km, zipped, with per-tile metadata and quarterly full-tile refreshes.
official_sources.limitation: Useful independent tile-coverage QA; not a substitute for EA 1m terminal source.

official_sources.title: OS Terrain 5 grid data structure
official_sources.finding: A 5km Terrain 5 tile is 1000x1000 cells at 5m spacing; values are pixel-centred and supplied with spatial-reference/metadata sidecars.
official_sources.limitation: Independent benchmark addressing must respect documented pixel-centre semantics.

official_sources.title: OS Terrain 5 tile metadata
official_sources.finding: Per-tile metadata records BNG, ODN, flying-date range, processing date, version and lineage; style aux.xml statistics are generic display aids.
official_sources.limitation: Display/statistics sidecars must not be mistaken for freshly computed exact extrema.

official_sources.title: OS Terrain 5 source TIN lineage
official_sources.finding: Terrain products are interpolated from a source TIN with modelling rules for significant features.
official_sources.limitation: Cross-product residuals are QA because the benchmark has different source/modelling lineage.

official_sources.title: OS Terrain 5 documentation/update cadence
official_sources.finding: OS Terrain 5 is a bare-earth DTM updated quarterly and supplied in 5km tiles.
official_sources.limitation: Benchmark release date/version must be captured for reproducibility.

official_sources.title: OS Terrain 5 technical specification
official_sources.finding: Terrain 5 uses EPSG:27700 and whole-tile refresh semantics; identifiers can change on tile refresh.
official_sources.limitation: Benchmark identity must include release/tile metadata, not only feature identifiers.

official_sources.title: OS Terrain 50 grid data structure
official_sources.finding: Terrain 50 grid uses 50m cells and 200x200 pixels per 10km tile, with values at pixel centres.
official_sources.limitation: Coarse QA addressing must not be resampled and presented as native parcel evidence.

official_sources.title: OS Terrain 5 downloads/resources
official_sources.finding: OS provides product schemas/resources separately from the downloadable product itself.
official_sources.limitation: Schema/resource provenance and actual data-tile provenance must remain separate.
